h1: Zambia business visa from the UK
intro: Travelling to Zambia for meetings, a conference or a trade fair? This page explains the Zambia business visa, who needs one and what to prepare. We check the rules for your passport and apply for you.
eligibility: You are travelling for meetings, conferences, trade fairs, negotiations or site visits
You won’t be paid by a company in Zambia
You have an invitation from the company or event you’re visiting

sections.heading: Do you need a Zambia business visa?
sections.text: British passport holders don't need a visa to enter Zambia for short visits, including business meetings. Working in Zambia needs a work permit.

sections.heading: What counts as a business visit?
sections.text:
Business visits usually include:
- Meetings with clients, suppliers or partners
- Conferences, exhibitions and trade fairs
- Negotiating or signing contracts
- Site visits and inspections

They don't include taking up paid work for a company in Zambia. That needs a work visa or permit.

sections.heading: Documents for a Zambia business visa
sections.text: The key document is the invitation letter from the company you're visiting. It should include your name and passport number, the purpose and dates of your visit, the company's address and contact details, and who is paying for the trip. A letter from your UK employer confirming your role helps too.

sections.heading: Zambia business visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We handle Zambia business visa applications for individuals and companies across the UK, including urgent trips. See our [corporate visa services](/corporate-clients/) if your staff travel regularly. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Zambia.

faqs.q: Can I attend a conference on a Zambia business visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Conferences, exhibitions and trade fairs are business visits.

faqs.q: Can I work in Zambia on a Zambia business visa?
faqs.a: No. Being paid by a local company, or doing hands-on work, usually needs a work visa or permit.

faqs.q: What should the invitation letter include?
faqs.a: Your name and passport number, the purpose and dates of your visit, the company’s details, and who is paying for the trip.
